notes: Default 'New' toggle on the High Stakes page: 10% step 1 target, 5% step 2.
Daily/max loss is 5%/10% on the $2.5K-$25K tabs and 4%/8% on the $50K and $100K tabs; the 50K/100K tiers carry dollar caps computed from those published percentages (4% and 8% of the account size).
Minimum is 3 profitable days per step; a profitable day is closed profit of at least 0.5% of the initial balance, so minTradingDays stores 3 as a floor, not a trading-day count.
Step 1 earns a fixed reward ($2/$5/$10/$15/$25/$40 by tier); the Pro Trader split starts at 80% and scales to 100% with the scaling plan.
News: trades 2 minutes before or after high-impact news are not allowed. Weekend and overnight holding allowed (indices carry a high weekend swap). Leverage 1:100. Platform MT5.
First payout 14 days after receiving a funded account, then every 2 weeks.

Drawdown static (rechecked 2026-10-21, FAQ 'last update: July 22, 2026'): 'The equity stop-out level (aka drawdown) is the lowest value of the account allowed. ... Example for Bootcamp: If the initial balance is $10,000 and the maximum drawdown 5% is $500, the account will be closed below the equity level of $9,500. Let’s say your account goes up to $10,300, the maximum drawdown is now $800.' (faqs/what-is-drawdown-and-how-is-it-calculated). The example's closing level does not rise: $10,300 - $800 = $9,500, the same stop-out level as at the start; only the loss allowance measured from current equity grows. The Bootcamp page (modified 2026-10-15) states only 'Max Loss 5% 5% 5% 4%' and the Terms (last update Oct. 20th 2026) do not describe the drawdown mechanism, so there is no conflicting first-party source. The FAQ also says payouts reduce the balance and hence the drawdown allowance.

consistencyRules.appliesTo: Per position, evaluation and funded (Pro Stage)

notes: Day Trade tab: $25K 'Price $59', $50K 'Price $100', each 'Refunded on 3rd payout.'; contracts 2 Mini/20 Micro and 4 Mini/40 Micro. 'All positions must be closed at least 10 minutes before market close'; 'No Weekend Holding'.

Overnight/weekend: 'Swing: You can hold 1 mini contract or 10 micro contracts overnight.' 'Day Trade: Overnight holding is not allowed.' 'Both programs: No weekend holding allowed. All positions must be closed at least 10 minutes before the Friday close.' (futures-faqs/overnight-holding-2, last update July 15, 2026). EA: 'Is High-Frequency Trading, Algorithmic Trading, or Hedging Permitted? No. These practices are strictly forbidden.' (futures-faqs/is-high-frequency-algorithmic-trading-and-hedging-allowed, October 12, 2026), so ea=false.

The5ers Futures (CME futures), checked 2026-10-21 from a US IP on https://the5ers.com/futures/ (tab-by-tab render, evidence /workspace/tradersfundhub/evidence/the5ers-2026-10-21b/futures-tabs.pw.txt). List prices from the programme page; checkout not reached (hub.the5ers.com/purchase?step=programs&asset=futures asks for sign-in), so not checkout-verified.

Page rows (Evaluation Phase / Pro Stage): 'Profit Target 6% 4%', 'Max Loss Limit 4% 4%', 'Drawdown Type EOD EOD', 'Consistency Rule – Per Position 40% 40%', 'Activation fee (Upon Passing) None None', 'Pass in one day ✓ -'. maxLossUsd is computed from the published 4% (not printed in dollars).

Drawdown: 'Both the Day Trade and Swing programs have a maximum drawdown of 4%, which is calculated from your highest midnight balance or equity.' (futures-faqs/what-is-my-maximum-drawdown-loss, last update July 15, 2026). No lock level is published, so none is stored.

Consistency: 'One trade cannot represent more than 40% of total profits. If it does, continue trading until its share falls to 40% or less.' (futures-faqs/what-are-the-general-rules-for-the-futures-program, last update October 12, 2026). It is per position, applied in evaluation and funded.

Split and payouts: 'The profit split is 80/20 in your favor across all accounts.' (futures-faqs/what-is-the-profit-split-in-the5ers-futures, July 15, 2026). Payout needs a funded account, 'You’ve reached 4% profit or more, calculated from your initial account balance' and 'The account is at least 14 days old' (futures-faqs/what-do-i-need-for-a-withdrawal, September 28, 2026); then 'biweekly (14-day period)', 3.5% commission on Rise, crypto and bank transfer (futures-faqs/what-payout-methods-are-supported, July 15, 2026).

Refund: 'Once you successfully receive your third payout on any funded futures trading account, we will refund the full evaluation fee you originally paid.' (futures-faqs/evaluation-fee-refund, July 20, 2026). refundable=true means this conditional full refund at the third payout, not a cancellation refund.

One-time fee: 'You pay a one-time upfront fee when purchasing an evaluation, and there are no recurring monthly payments on either program.' (futures-faqs/is-there-a-monthly-subscription-during-the-evaluation, August 10, 2026). News: 'News trading: Allowed.' (general rules FAQ). Copy trading between own accounts and platform not recorded here.

Country rules: no futures-specific list is published; the Terms ('Last update – Oct. 20th 2026') say the services include 'proprietary trading on Contract for Difference and Futures Contract', and the site-wide Forbidden Territories footer (Russia, Belarus, Crimea named) is shown on /futures/.
